purpose: Use the special ambient linear strain h_A(Y,Z)=2<Y,A Z> on the unit S3/RP3 background to simplify the Gamma_A Gamma_B product operator before C11 integration.

geometric_derivation.ambient_first_strain: h_A(Y,Z)=2<Y,A Z> for tangent Y,Z and constant symmetric ambient A
geometric_derivation.tangent_vector_definition: a_A=(A x)^T = A x - <A x,x>x; for tangent Z, <Z,A x>=<Z,a_A>
geometric_derivation.first_connection: Gamma_A^p_ij=-2 g_ij a_A^p on the round three-dimensional background

product_operator_simplification.dimension_factor: The coefficient 12 uses dim(S3)=3 through g^{ij}g_ij=3.
product_operator_simplification.scope: Gamma_A Gamma_B product slot only; single Gamma_AB, inverse-metric/first-connection, Ricci, projector, Hilbert/basis, and local pieces are not included.

C11_integrand_template.quotient: Use quotient-orthonormal n=1 Killing one-forms on L(2,1); no extra global cover factor.

matrix_structure_implication.operator_rank_per_pair: At most rank 2 on the one-form fiber before spatial integration, generated by a_A and a_B contractions.
matrix_structure_implication.possible_next_computation: Evaluate integrals of pairings between Killing fields Eij and tangential projections a_A=(Ax)^T.
matrix_structure_implication.integration_reduction: The remaining integrals are quartic moments on S3/RP3 of linear ambient fields; antipodal quotient keeps the same normalized moment values after quotient orthonormalization bookkeeping.

what_is_now_ready: The product contribution no longer needs full Christoffel-symbol tensor expansion for the ambient linear path.
C_conn2_product[1,1] reduces to pairings of six Killing one-forms with tangential ambient gradient fields a_A and a_B.
The next computation can be a finite moment calculation rather than a large index tensor contraction.
what_is_still_missing: choose the explicit 10-element Sym^2(R4) deformation basis and its normalization
compute the 6x10 overlap matrix M_{rA}=Integral <E_r,a_A><...> style moments needed by the bilinear formula
combine with the non-product connection slots and all other delta2 operator pieces before any determinant claim

pass_fail.meaning: For the locked ambient strain path, C_A collapses to -4 g times the tangent covector a_A.
The A/B-symmetrized product operator is -12 times the symmetric rank-two contraction with a_A and a_B.
No six-state quotient integrals have been evaluated yet.

plain_language: The product gear got much smaller: instead of a bulky Christoffel product, it is just two tangent arrows a_A and a_B pushing against the input one-form. The numbers are still missing, but the next calculation is now a finite moment integral.
verdict: The Gamma_A Gamma_B product slot for the locked ambient path simplifies to P_AB(alpha)=-12[a_A<a_B,alpha>+a_B<a_A,alpha>]. This is a genuine reduction toward C_conn2_product[1,1], but it remains only the product subslot; quotient Killing-basis integrals and the rest of delta2 Delta_1 are still open.
